sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module is designed to be taught in semester 2 of the MRes Management degree and follows the teaching of three modules, taught in semester 1, which cover the research process, qualitative methods, and quantitative methods. Although these semester 1 modules place an emphasis on developing an understanding and skills necessary to undertake a dissertation, a student will also require an understanding of how to write a thesis. The aim of this module, therefore, is to equip students with the knowledge and practical skills required to develop and write the MRes Management dissertation.
sections.Learning outcomes: A) Demonstrate comprehension of academic texts and research theses, with an emphasis on critical analysis. B) Comprehend the structure of research theses and academic texts, based on a knowledge of the research process. C) Plan, structure, and produce the individual sections of an MRes thesis, which together form a coherent dissertation.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Lecture and discussions: Description: Each session will involve periods of lecturing from the module leader. Purpose: To impart foundational knowledge to the students. Writing exercises Description: Students will practice writing sections/elements of a thesis. Purpose: For developing their understanding of the individual sections, which form a thesis/manuscripts, and to develop their writing skills. Analysis Exercises Description: Students will analyse existing manuscripts. Purpose: To provide illustrative examples of how to write the individual sections of a thesis.
